title: BUGFIX — produce-vlog: add HeyGen→ElevenLabs fallback in produceVlog()
rationale: In scripts/scs001/produce-vlog.ts produceVlog() at lines 885-891, the generateAvatar() call (HeyGen API) has no error handling. If HEYGEN_API_KEY is missing, HeyGen quota is exceeded, or the API returns an error, the entire educational pipeline fails. generateTTSBackbone() (ElevenLabs TTS) already exists as a lower-cost alternative but is only used when mode='tts'. Fix: wrap generateAvatar() in try/catch and call generateTTSBackbone() on failure. This makes the educational pipeline resilient when HeyGen is unavailable — same pattern as Sprints 1327-1329 (LLM scriptgen fallbacks).

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/produce-vlog.ts produceVlog() (around line 889): wrap the `await generateAvatar()` call in a try/catch. On catch: log '[produce-vlog] HeyGen failed (err.message) — falling back to TTS backbone' and call `await generateTTSBackbone(script.full_monologue, avatarPath)`. Keep the `if (mode === 'tts')` path unchanged.
